previous_assumption: Assumed acceptQuotation just needed to flag renter_accepted_at=true on the quotation's current rate field, and that the frontend calling acceptOffer then acceptQuotation in sequence (when adding the Rental Company's own counter-offer trigger) was sufficient to keep the accepted rate correct.
correction: User caught this live via a screenshot: the 'Your decision' panel said the Rental Company countered at 11750/shift, but the Offer trail directly below showed the actual pending counter at 11650/shift — commercial_quotations.rate is only ever updated by applyAcceptedOffer/updateTerms, so while a counter-offer sits pending (created but not yet accepted), rate is stale, and the frontend read that stale field directly for both the display copy and the Accept button. Fixed at the actual enforcement point: acceptQuotation now looks up quotation_offers itself, and if a pending offer from the OTHER party exists, applies it (accepts the offer + applyAcceptedOffer) before recording renter_accepted_at — this holds regardless of which client calls acceptQuotation, not just the one UI path. Frontend also fixed to read the real pending offer's rate for display, and to show a 'waiting for a response' state instead of an Accept button when the only pending offer is the Renter's own (nothing new from the counterparty to accept). This mattered financially: awardQuotation creates the Rental from commercial_quotations.rate, so the stale-rate bug would have silently attached the wrong price to a real Rental.
